title: triple-sdk-refresh-scheduler-and-stream-ergonomics-bump
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Backported refresh-scheduler and stream ergonomics to Python/TS/Go SDKs; bump versions: py 3.5.0, ts 1.28.0, go 1.8.3. Notable: improved token refresh jitter, new retry presets, clarified stream resume semantics in docs.
description: Motivation: Customers running long-lived streaming connections saw spiky reauth storms when multiple clients refreshed tokens synchronously. This PR introduces a cross-language refresh scheduler plus ergonomics improvements to streaming APIs and aligns retry/default presets across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Summary: 1) Add a refresh scheduler that centralizes token refresh jitter and backoff windows so SDKs avoid synchronized refreshes across processes. 2) Expose a lightweight StreamHandle interface with explicit resume semantics and an ergonomic async iterator wrapper in all SDKs to reduce developer boilerplate. 3) Introduce new retry profiles (fast-fail, conservative, and balanced) and wire them into SDK defaults. 4) Small parity fixes: align header names, session TTL handling, and error typing across languages. 5) Version bumps and CHANGELOG entries for each SDK. Checklist: [x] Design doc and cross-team review (ENG-2145) [x] Unit+integration tests for scheduler and stream resume [x] Manual interop test: py <-> ts stream handoff [x] Docs update and migration notes [x] Release notes.

migration_notes: Apps relying on implicit per-call refresh should update to use the session manager or set REFRESH_STRATEGY=inline until deprecated in next major. Stream consumers: if you previously relied on implicit reconnection semantics, use StreamHandle.resume() to explicitly claim resume tokens.
notes_for_release_team: Coordinate paired SDK release: py 3.5.0, ts 1.28.0, go 1.8.3. Notify SRE about reduced reauth spikes and ask to monitor /auth/refresh failures for 72h after rollout.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for jittered scheduling, integration test that spins up local auth proxy to emulate staggered TTLs, and an e2e script that exercises cross-sdk stream resume. See tests/integration/refresh_storm_sim.py for python harness.
